description: Reconciles multiple touches into a single gesture. Provides a predictable wrapper around gesture responder system and works well with Animated for complex gestures.

gestureState.stateID: ID of the gestureState, persists as long as at least one touch is active
gestureState.moveX: Latest X coordinate of the most recently moved touch
gestureState.moveY: Latest Y coordinate of the most recently moved touch
gestureState.x0: X coordinate when gesture was granted
gestureState.y0: Y coordinate when gesture was granted
gestureState.dx: Accumulated horizontal distance since gesture started
gestureState.dy: Accumulated vertical distance since gesture started
gestureState.numberActiveTouches: Number of touches currently on screen

create.description: Creates a PanResponder instance with provided callback configuration.

parameters.config: object, required. Provides enhanced versions of all typical onResponder* callbacks, each receiving (event, gestureState).

notes: Works well with Animated API to handle drag gestures.
onStartShould* callbacks reflect gesture state only for start/end events; once responder is active, gestureState updates reliably.
numberActiveTouches may be inaccurate unless this view is the responder.
